<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, touching **41** documentable anchor(s).

**44** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6e766012f59c35b66072a012f56e06b9c2bbf55a`.

⛔ **9** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **5** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **231** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **166** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **166**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **107** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **22** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6e766012f59c35b66072a012f56e06b9c2bbf55a` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `2c94201f8b5629f0b289124f03f707ff2c765f52` — the merge of head `e5aa77ce3914547f9686bff6f92c1fd9d7a7519b` into base `6e766012f59c35b66072a012f56e06b9c2bbf55a`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 2c94201f8b5629f0b289124f03f707ff2c765f52 && git checkout 2c94201f8b5629f0b289124f03f707ff2c765f52
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 6e766012f59c35b66072a012f56e06b9c2bbf55a e5aa77ce3914547f9686bff6f92c1fd9d7a7519b && git checkout -B drift-repro 6e766012f59c35b66072a012f56e06b9c2bbf55a && git merge --no-ff e5aa77ce3914547f9686bff6f92c1fd9d7a7519b

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6e766012f59c35b66072a012f56e06b9c2bbf55a
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 6e766012f59c35b66072a012f56e06b9c2bbf55a` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `3cab23ce5da5ce17274b0a6f304ef8acbd681395`
Local-runs: none

### ① Derived judgments

- **Face:** the declaration only. `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is on the PR body and the changeset. The diff touches no `packages/spec/src/**` source and no governed path, and declares no narrowing.
- **The widening:** one new session-required route, `POST /api/v1/auth/oauth-consent/request`, entered in the auth route ledger as `server-only` with no SDK method. It answers `{ clientId, redirectUri, registeredByAdministrator }`, `Cache-Control: no-store`. No existing route, field or answer changes shape.
- **Against the order's rule:**
  - `redirectUri` is read from the signed authorization request only after the provider's own `verifyOAuthQueryParams` check, under the auth instance's secret. That is the same check `/oauth2/consent` runs, so the value is the redirect a consent sends the code to. Nothing the client declared at registration feeds it, and no other key of the body does either.
  - `registeredByAdministrator` is read from the stored row's `user_id` (named columns only, system read) and that account's platform-admin standing through core's fail-closed `hasPlatformAdminStanding`. Every other client, a dynamically registered one included, reads `false`, and the page marks it unverified.
  - The page names the redirect host (an http(s) redirect, a loopback one included) or shows a non-http redirect as it is. Authorize stays disabled until the server confirms the destination; Deny always works.
- **Reading the dev settled, and the seat accepts:** a client a signed-in non-administrator registered through the self-service door carries the unverified mark too. This is the only reading under which both sentences of the order's rule hold: the stored row carries no registration-source column, and standing is judged at read time, which fails closed. Whether registration itself is narrowed stays outside this PR.
- **Refusals:** 401 before the body is read; a held session gets its posture's 403; any query parameter, an unknown body key, a missing `oauth_query`, an unsigned or expired request, or one naming other than exactly one `client_id` and `redirect_uri` gets 400; a client that does not exist or is disabled gets 404.

### ② Semver level

Patch for `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, `@object-ui/console` and `@object-ui/i18n`. The change is additive: a new server-only route and new console strings. This follows the repo's practice for a declared widening on these packages.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Not governed; no published schema; 19 files, +959/−9, under the human-merge threshold.
- The new strings are in all 11 console locales, and the i18n suite's key-parity check passes.
- Public text (title, body, changeset, test names) states the rule only.
- Author: `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay).
- Noted, not a finding: the consent page reaches the new route with raw `fetch`, like its existing public-client read. The route is recorded as server-only, with no SDK method.

Implemented-by: `claude/sec2-p4cc`
Reviewed-by: `session_01QSeKYn5CmmdShCJifm6WYj`

**VERDICT: PASS**
